name: Microsoft AutoGen
description: Microsoft 的多智能体应用框架，提供 AgentChat、Core、Extensions 和 AutoGen Studio

methods.name: 独立虚拟环境安装（推荐）
methods.command: base="$HOME/.local/share/ai-hub/microsoft-autogen"; mkdir -p "$base"; python3 -m venv "$base/.venv" && "$base/.venv/bin/python" -m pip install -U pip && "$base/.venv/bin/pip" install -U autogen-agentchat 'autogen-ext[openai]' autogenstudio

post_install.description: 显示 AutoGen Studio 启动方式
post_install.command: echo 'AutoGen 已安装到 ~/.local/share/ai-hub/microsoft-autogen；Studio 可运行：ai-hub.sh 操作 -> start-studio'

operations.view: sed -n '1,120p' "$HOME/.local/share/ai-hub/microsoft-autogen/.env" 2>/dev/null || echo '配置文件不存在（请通过环境变量配置 API Key）'

status_check.name: 检查 AutoGen 环境
status_check.command: test -x "$HOME/.local/share/ai-hub/microsoft-autogen/.venv/bin/python" && "$HOME/.local/share/ai-hub/microsoft-autogen/.venv/bin/python" -c 'import autogen_agentchat' && echo '已安装' || echo '未安装'

status_check.name: 检查 Studio
status_check.command: curl -fsS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8081 >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'Studio 运行中' || echo 'Studio 未运行'

notes: 官方仓库已说明 AutoGen 进入 maintenance mode；存量项目可继续使用，新项目建议评估 Microsoft Agent Framework。
